items.title: At the Game: Ball State
items.summary: BOWLING GREEN, Ohio — Bowling Green will complete their in-conference homestand on Saturday as they square off against the Ball State Cardinals. Kickoff at Doyt Perry Stadium is set for Saturday at 12 p.m.

items.title: BGSU Football Announces 2027 Non-Conference Schedule, Homecoming Date
items.summary: BOWLING GREEN, Ohio - Bowling Green State University has finalized the 2027 non-conference football schedule for the Falcons, including the date for Homecoming 2027. The Falcons will host Homecoming 2027 on Sept. 18 against Mercyhurst.
